title: Among schools with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, return the school nam
question: Among schools with an SAT excellence rate above 0.25, return the school name, county, and eligible free or reduced price meal rate for students aged 5–17, but only for schools in counties where the number of directly funded charter schools exceeds the number of locally funded ones. Limit to the top 3 results by FRPM rate (ages 5–17) in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_counties AS (
    SELECT "XCL_045" AS county
    FROM schools
    GROUP BY "XCL_045"
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_063" = 1 AND "XCL_065" = 'Directly funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
         > SUM(CASE WHEN "XCL_063" = 1 AND "XCL_065" = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
)
SELECT
    s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
    s."XCL_045" AS county,
    (f."XCL_025" + f."XCL_027") / f."XCL_024" AS frpm_rate
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN qualifying_counties qc ON s."XCL_045" = qc.county
WHERE CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" > 0.25
ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC
LIMIT 3
